description: ÖPNV-Haltestellen Bietigheim-Bissingen is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open.
